body:
I synced the files

I also tried running the CLI via my terminal on those same files on my
local disk (when I found the problem, originally I was running on a server
via an NFS connection), results below, *and could not reproduce the
problem. *

I then tried running the code I have (which invokes the CLI) pointed at the
same files on my local drive, and also on the NFS share. I could not
reproduce the problem.

So my only guess here is that it is some kind of race condition happening.

I suggest that given the above evidence, and the fact this may be a rare
edge case that we close this ticket (won't solve). I have a workaround in
place which works, which involves invoking exiftool to get around this
problem.

Thanks for your attention Alberto, but I won't waste your time on this any
further.




----------
